text:
Evelyn: Proposal: reflow the left rail into a two-tier "context + actions" pattern. Top shows current workspace (global context), second tier shows contextual sections (Overview, Jobs, Artifacts, Routes) as a collapsible list. Aim is fewer top-level items and clearer scoping.
Marco: Sounds promising. Key constraint: deep links must still land reliably. If a user bookmarks /routes/234 we need to expand the correct context and highlight the item without changing the canonical path.
Tanisha: Routing contract idea: canonical URLs remain flat (e.g., /workspaces/:wsId/routes/:routeId). On client hydrate, find sidebar node for the path, expand its ancestor context(s), set a visible indicator on the parent, and focus the leaf only when the navigation is from an external entry (bookmark/link). No hash fragments.
Devon: Implementation detail: route-to-node mapping should prefer more specific static prefixes. Pseudocode: sort patterns by static segment count, then match. Use sidebar order as final tie-breaker.
Evelyn: Breadcrumbs: show scoped path: WorkspaceName > Routes > RouteName. Avoid repeating a literal "context" label twice. If context name differs from folder label, show both humanized.
Tanisha: Accessibility notes: context header MUST be a button with aria-expanded and aria-controls. When expanded, place a polite live region message like "Routes expanded". Honor prefers-reduced-motion for expand animations.
Accessibility-Bot: Reminder: include SR text for the indicator: "contains active item" when a subtree contains the current route.
Marco: Visual affordance options: 1) subtle dot on contextual header, 2) thin left accent bar on header, 3) highlight child only. Quick react poll: :one: dot, :two: accent bar, :three: child-only.
Evelyn: UX preference leans to accent bar (:two:). It signals scope without duplicating the child highlight.
Devon: Edge cases: overlapping slugs across contexts (e.g., /workspaces/:id/jobs/:id vs /projects/:id/jobs/:id). Resolution: exact prefix longest match, then sidebar order. Also normalize URLs to strip duplicate slashes and ensure trailing slash behavior is canonicalized server-side with 301s.
Tanisha: Focus behavior: only autofocus on initial hard load. If the user clicks inside the app to change routes, do not steal focus from the main content. However, when user navigates via keyboard to expand a context, focus should move into the newly exposed first child.
Marco: For ARIA and tab order: collapsed children should have aria-hidden=true and tabindex=-1. When opened, set aria-hidden=false and restore natural tab order.
Evelyn: Test plan: unit tests for findNodeForPath matching and aria-expanded toggles, integration test for landing on deep link with collapsed context (should expand & focus), accessibility smoke test for SR announcements and reduced-motion.
Devon: Small dev note: if client receives an unknown path that looks like a child of multiple contexts, log an analytic event and fall back to top-level workspace view rather than guessing.
Tanisha: Copy nits: in breadcrumbs prefer user-facing names rather than slugs; fallback to slug only if no displayName available. Also microcopy for the context button: "Show Routes" / "Hide Routes" instead of generic "Expand".
Accessibility-Bot: Also add a skip-link "Skip to main content" at top of page for keyboard users landing from external links.
Evelyn: I'll draft the RFC with examples, code snippets for hydrate flow, ARIA checklist, and the Figma frames for accent-bar and reduced-motion. Tagging @Marco and @Tanisha for review.
Marco: :thumbsup:
Devon: :eyes:
Tanisha: Thanks all, will add unit test stubs to the PR.
